title: Nvidia’s stock drops as board reportedly preps to oust CEO Jensen Huang | TechCrunch
summary: Nvidia is reportedly planning to oust its co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang, who has led the company for the last 33 years, the Wall Street Journal reports . The company also has not had an obvious successor or a succession plan.
